title: Lombard Odier亚洲CIO：新经济板块仅占中国经济的15-20%，但机会充足
speaker: John Woods

segments.en: We don't see it ending we seem to have a new entrant every quarter or so and it just adds to the momentum behind as I say the tech the AI the renewables the green energy space which is driving that part of the economy.
segments.zh: 我们认为这一趋势不会结束，几乎每个季度都有新参与者加入，这为科技、人工智能、可再生能源和绿色能源领域增添了动力，推动着经济的那一部分。

segments.en: It is eminently investible in our minds but it's important to caution that it's probably only 15 to 20% of the economy.
segments.zh: 在我们看来，这非常值得配置，但需要提醒的是，它可能只占经济的15%到20%。

segments.en: There's a there's perhaps a more constrained landscape out there which is a bit of a little more challenged as we saw from the China numbers published a couple of data yesterday but overall as I say we still see ample opportunity in the in the new entrance space.
segments.zh: 另一方面，可能有一些领域面临更多挑战，正如我们从昨天发布的中国数据中看到的，但总体而言，我们仍然在新经济领域看到充足的机会。

segments.en: So the new China is how would you play that is that more onshore playing now because the hardware is there or is it the monetization place that you get off shore like Hong Kong. Yes both to an extent we see a lot more tech in the MSEI China index so that is much more of a new China way of playing it and absolutely the same in the H share market as well but there are onshore opportunities as well maybe single line.
segments.zh: 那么新经济中国如何布局？是在岸市场还是离岸市场？两者都有一定机会。我们在MSCI中国指数中看到更多科技股，这更多是新经济中国的玩法，H股市场也是如此，但在岸市场也有机会，可能是个股机会。
